description: Retrieves all registered roles — board members (styre), CEO (daglig leder), chair (styreleder), auditor (revisor), sole proprietor (innehaver), etc. — for a Norwegian company. Returns structured role groups with person or entity role-holders. Does NOT include personal identification numbers (that requires Maskinporten auth).
name: get_company_roles
title: Get roles (board, directors, auditor) of a company
